newsitem.title: USA: Control Data to buy back one mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Control Data to buy back one mln shares.

text.p: Control Data Systems Inc said Monday it intend to purchase up to one million shares of the company's common stock based on current price levels under a share repurchase program announced on July 25, 1996.
The repurchase program authorizes the company to make purchases of Control Data common stock from time to time in the open market or through privately negotiated transactions.
Control Data has 13.7 million shares outstanding and about 14.7 million fully diluted shares.

"Control Data has significant financial resources and cash-generating capabilities and this program allows the company to return cash to its shareholders, while minimizing future earnings per share dilution resulting from employee stock benefit plans," said James Ousley, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
Control Data provides software and services which allow organizations to transmit and access electronic information.
